shown.message:
The positive control is finished. It found no detected departure in any of the 68 rows on either graph, so Δ(log Q) has no demonstrated power to detect misfit. The SE ratio does respond: it reaches a design effect of 6.2 on the MT-Bench human graph.

I read the delivered v1 abstract and §4.3. Both already say this: the comparison with the null reference has limited power, and the design shows up in the interval width, not in the count. I did not read every paper section.

The Arena-55k control has a limit the paper should state wherever its rows appear. The injected overdispersion acts per random block of 20 comparisons, so it behaves almost like pair-independent noise. The SE ratio there rises only from 0.82 to 0.94. `experiment-repo` has asked `paper-repo` to add the Arena rows (Table 4, Fig. 6) and this limitation. I did not check that this is done.

Every point from my reviews of the Brief, the Outline and `experiment-repo`'s analysis plan was adopted. I closed my commitment (#2) with a summary of the reviews and the two items left with their owners. I'll review again if the Brief or Outline change materially.
